title: Huney Knuckles
description: HUGE NOISE, world class musicianship, mind-bending solos, and uber funky jams Kevin Wong, Darian Gray, Tony Peebles & Bian Sheu 9pm-12:30am / $7 The newest kids on the block, the Huney Knuckles (formerly the Black Star Pirates) combines the left hand keyboard bass wizardry of Kevin Wong with the indomitable pocket of Darian Gray, touring drummer for Booker T Jones for the past 14 years. Founded in early 2021, the Huney Knuckles were birthed during the quarantine at Black Star Pirate BBQ when they teamed up with Grammy winning saxophonist Tony Peebles & Virtuoso guitarist Brian Sheu to bring the joy of live music to one of the first places in town to host socially distanced outdoor live music. Fusing watertight grooves with high energy shreds that will make you want to jump out of your seat, this 4-piece has made a huge noise in the local scene, drawing new fans left & right at every show with their world class musicianship, mind-bending solos, and uber-funky jams.

title: Let's Go Disco
description: Saturday September 26 in San Francisco… Welcoming, @Timo._.Lee (nyc) Splitting her roots between Taiwan and Hawaii, Timo spent a decade shaping Honolulu’s underground dance music scene. Now anchored in New York, she has become a fixture in the city’s nightlife ecosystem, with regular sets at The Lot Radio and venues like Good Room. She’s also the boss of @ChompChompRecords -shaping 90s rave culture, breakbeat, acid, house, and global electronic club music into a driving force for emerging talent. Timo has shared the stage with DJ Harvey, Bonobo, James Murphy, Thomas Bullock, DJ Garth, Tiger and Woods, Daniele Baldelli and Tim Sweeney, to name drop a few. Early arrival recommended. Be yourself. Dress to dance. motel club presents LET’S GO DISCO with Timo Lee Saturday Sept 26 Madrone San Francisco 9:30 @Timo._.Lee @ChompChompRecords @Motel.Club Guarantee your spot!

title: APOCALYPSE SUNDAY
description: So what exactly is APOCALYPSE SUNDAY? Consider it a sort-of variety show for people with very few options left. Primarily a musical revue, APOCALYPSE SUNDAY features the music of Bay Area horrorbilly faves The Pine Box Boys, singers of songs of murder and misery. The Boys will also appear as their alter-ego band Lester T. Raww’s Graveside Quartet, whose music has been described as “Tin Pan Alley charm, with Addams Family grim.” Rounding out the regular entertainment is “Gentleman” Jimmy Hadley and his songs of debauchery and poor life choices. And since variety is the spice of life, each week will feature another SF/Bay Area band or artist. 5-8PM

title: Thirst Draft: Write Drunk, Edit Never
description: An event for writers — and for writing. Everyone gets the same prompt when they walk in the door. What ends up on the page is up to you! Here’s how it works: Write whatever you want — poem, song, short story, joke… anything works! Interpret the prompt however you like, but try to incorporate it in some way Work alone or collaborate with friends/strangers — no word count or time limit Sign up by 7pm if you want to share your piece on stage, just like an open mic Want to join, but can’t make it by 6 pm? All good! Here are some loose times to keep in mind: Write & Mingle: 6pm to 7pm Share on Stage: 7pm to 8pm Drink & Discuss: 8pm to 9pm No cover, no editing, no AI. Pens and paper will be available, but bring your own if you can. Tip your bartenders and support your fellow writers.

title: Schwartzy: Release Party
description:
“Light Longs For Us” Release Party
with Visual Projections by Robert Malmberg

Join us for a special evening celebrating the upcoming release of Schwartzy’s new EP, Light Longs For Us.

The night will feature a live performance of the new music accompanied by immersive visual projections from Schwartzy’s longtime creative collaborator Robert Malmberg, creating a singular audiovisual experience designed specifically for the evening.

Following the performance, we’ll keep things moving with a DJ set late into the night—a chance to celebrate the record, spend time with friends old and new, and experience Light Longs For Us in a form that won’t exist anywhere else.

To mark the occasion, two tracks from the new EP will be available on a limited-edition 7” vinyl, exclusively at the event. Take home a piece of the night before the full digital release

title: The Last Wild Buffalo
description: The Last Wild Buffalo is a soulful Americana band from Utah, blending the raw honesty of folk with the grit and energy of rock. Born in backyards, forged through relentless touring, and shaped by the landscapes and communities that raised them, the band has built a reputation for heartfelt songwriting and high-impact live performances that turn every crowd into a community. Since forming in June 2024, they have steadily built a grassroots following through self-funded touring, the release of their self-titled debut album and surprise EP Sincerely, and a second full-length album, Still Here, Somehow, which was released in April 2026.
